d:
Ghost Game finally got dubbed a few months ago! Jellymon's probably my new favorite Digimon of all time. Mesugaki coded as hell. Wish she got more panels in this one.

Quite the bizarre plot. Seems Jellymon's partner Kiyoshiro can only get off to NTR content so Jellymon's helping him out. Explains how she's arriving already digivolved. XD
